reviews.review:
Ive only played about 3-4 hours of this game as of writing this and I think thats most likely going to be it for this game for me.

My thoughts so far are

Good:
* characters look good
This is not a game where you play as a walking trashbin. Also the female characters are not ugly, which for some reason is worth mentioning nowadays.
* during gamplay "movement" is fluid
Some games just have a janky sprinting or movement animation. This game managed to do this well.
* works on linux without any issues or problems
I know not relevent for most people but still appreciated by me.

Bad:
* Repetitive generic "looter shooter content"
You get to do fun things like, defend a point for 5 minutes, followed by thats right defend 5 more points for 5 minutes each to get to an actual "story?" mission. Dont forget we also have the carry item across the map to point A, B and then C missions, or fetch Items and collect them at a drop box. Yaay fun.

* Loot is boring
You have a bunch of types weapons that you can shoot that use different types of ammo so you have to vary them a bit but in general you do not find "different" weapons you just find the same ones over and over again just with slightly better stats. The "modules" to modify the weapons exist but I didnt bother learning them since the game suggested to just use "auto best" for them. 

* Story makes little sense
The games plot appears to revolve around a mc-guffin device or several of them. Such plots are never really intresting to me. Also these "aliens" you are fighting are really poorly explained. The world in general is quite poorly explained. I dont weigh this much since this doesnt try to be a rpg, but damn some effort in this department to not make it appear "insane" after about 30 minutes of playing wouldnt have been out of place in my opinion.

* Combat system is not that fun.
The abilities of your character appear to be only slightly useful. The character I picked had a useless movement ability. 1 AOE damage that sometimes took out a group of 3 "grunts" but sometimes was just useless/buggy? and did no damage at all. 1 Close range AOE that would do decent damage when an enemy got too close to you, which rarely happened. So you are basically just standing there shooting your guns (usually some SMG/Assault rifle type of weapon) or a sniper rifle and its all a point and click adventure really. Theres no cover system, no reason to move much and the only times you are "in danger" is if the enemies happen to respawn all around you while you are reloading or if you dont kill them fast enough. I am pretty terrible at FPS games but even I didnt die once in the first 4 hours. Its fair to say this game is very easy. 

Neutral:
* Microtransactions
Well they have to make the money somehow, since this game is free I am tolerant to this stuff. It contains the usual play to wait mechanics with the option to spend $ to speed things up, the usual grind the ♥♥♥♥ or pay $ and ofc skins appears to only be available if you spend $
